title: Let the database reject bad data
why_it_matters: Constraints protect you even when your app code has a bug.
explanation: not null forbids empty values. check enforces a rule, like nights above zero. unique stops duplicates, like two accounts with the same email. Database rules apply to every client, so they are your last line of defense.
try_it: Try to insert a booking with 0 nights and read the error.
